description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Order to impose Special Commodity Levy on other - Maize. This order shall be valid for a period of 31 days Commencing from 1st February 2019
categorisation: This gazette content is an order issued under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007, imposing specific levy rates on commodities. It constitutes a regulatory instrument that establishes compliance requirements for trade, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure categories. The mention of the Minister's name is incidental to the regulatory action being taken.
